title: Reads from the controller tapes
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and fix a schedule-alphabet input, a base configuration, a controller phase, an input-head position, integer controller-head positions $b,u,g$, and controller tapes $\beta,\mu,\gamma$. In the resulting setup configuration, the symbols read from the budget, unary, and guide tapes are respectively $\beta(b)$, $\mu(u)$, and $\gamma(g)$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
a schedule-alphabet input and base configuration
a controller phase and input-head position
replaced:
In a setup configuration with controller tapes $\beta, \mu, \gamma$ and heads at
$b, u, g$, the symbols read from the three controller tapes are $\beta(b)$, $\mu(u)$,
and $\gamma(g)$ respectively.
